decision: Frozen v6 mapping remains failed. A separate 1% XY dilation plus 1% per-species deletion copy passes the real LAMMPS mapping check before and after a short cold NVT/NVE, but fails the exploratory two-phase cold-temperature criterion. Do not start source/no-source TTM until Ag/W cold temperatures are brought into acceptable agreement and the density/force impact of the tuning is reviewed.
limitations: The 20 A transfer radius is an exploratory locality screen, not a calibrated physical length.
The v5 mask is a reconstructed geometry with exactly preserved W voxel count; its phase fractions are not verified as the frozen restart's local atomic-density field.
No TTM step or laser source is executed by this scan.
The v5 EFS static audit remains failed and Ag/W interface conductance remains exploratory.
